notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.46

• Settings is its own app now — it stays open and shows in Recents instead of closing by itself.
• Dynamic Island: cancelling a timer from the island actually stops it now, and it opens more smoothly.
• DuckAI answers faster.
• The Bug Report icon now matches the clean one from inside the app.
• Removed Paint and Music Maker.
• New: Test crash detection in Settings › Safety — see the alert without dropping your phone.
